name: Meeting Sync
description: Sync meetings from Granola or Otter to your local vault. Classifies by type (investor, prospect, recruiting, team, board, partner, discovery), extracts follow-ups with owner tags, and flags meetings for GitHub knowledge sharing.
when_to_use: After meetings to capture notes, action items, and intelligence. Run daily or use overnight automation.
author: Christopher

name: Morning Check-in
description: Structured morning briefing that sweeps Slack, Gmail, calendar, Thoughtful, and task lists. Runs a silent data gather, surfaces questions you need to answer, then delivers a tight 1-2 day briefing.
when_to_use: Start of day. Replaces manual tab-switching across Slack, email, calendar, and task tools.
author: Christopher

name: Session Wrap
description: End-of-session command that archives your work, updates your daily log with forward implications, and pushes open items to your task tracker. Prevents context loss between sessions.
when_to_use: End of any working session. Captures decisions, action items, and what downstream work is affected.
author: Christopher

name: Trello Sync
description: Deterministic Trello card creation and completion from JSON payloads. Creates cards with owner prefixes, deduplicates against existing cards, and supports cross-board promotion.
when_to_use: When skills or automations need to create or complete Trello cards programmatically. Used by check-in and wrap under the hood.
author: Christopher

name: Setup
description: Interactive onboarding skill that configures your Claude Code environment. Walks you through connecting Granola/Otter, Slack, Thoughtful, Trello, and other integrations.
when_to_use: First time setting up Claude Code skills, or when adding a new integration.
author: Christopher
